privacy.label: Privacy Policy
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This page explains how Hotel Ristorante San Michele processes the personal data of website visitors and those who contact us via the inquiry form, in accordance with EU Regulation 2016/679 (GDPR) and Legislative Decree 196/2003.

sections.title: 1. Data Controller
paragraphs: Hotel Ristorante San Michele — Via S. Michele, 5a, 25050 Ome (BS) — VAT No. 03524900986.
If you have any questions about your personal data, please email hotelsanmicheleome@gmail.com or call +39 030 3378060.

sections.title: 2. What Data Do We Collect?
paragraphs: Information you provide to us: When you fill out the information request form on the Contact Us page, we collect your first and last name, email address, phone number (optional), the subject of your request (hotel or restaurant), and the text of your message.
If you provide us with information such as food allergies or intolerances in your message, we will use it only to fulfill your request and for no other purpose.

Browsing data: The servers that host the website automatically record certain technical data (IP address, browser type, date and time of access) necessary for the website's operation and security. We do not use this data to identify you.

sections.title: 3. Why We Use Them
paragraphs: • Respond to your requests for information about hotels and restaurants (legal basis: taking steps at your request prior to entering into a contract, Art. 6.1.b of the GDPR).
• To ensure the security and proper functioning of the website (legal basis: the data controller’s legitimate interest, Art. 6.1.f of the GDPR).
We do not use your information to send you advertisements or newsletters, and we do not sell it to anyone.

sections.title: 4. Who Can View the Data
paragraphs: The data is processed only by hotel and restaurant staff responsible for responding to inquiries.

To operate the website, we rely on certain service providers that act as data processors: Vercel Inc. (website hosting) and Google Ireland Ltd (Gmail email service, through which we receive form submissions). These service providers may process data outside the European Union, in compliance with the safeguards provided by the GDPR (EU-US Data Privacy Framework and standard contractual clauses).

sections.title: 5. How long do we keep them?
paragraphs: We retain request data for as long as necessary to process them, but in any case no longer than 24 months from the last contact, unless we are required by law to retain them for a longer period (for example, for tax purposes in the case of an actual stay or service purchased).

sections.title: 6. Is it mandatory to provide this information?
paragraphs: No, but without your name and email address, we can't respond to your request. The other fields on the form are optional.

sections.title: 7. Your Rights
paragraphs: At any time, you may ask us to access your data, correct it, delete it, restrict its use, object to its processing, or receive a copy of it (Articles 15–22 of the GDPR). Simply write to hotelsanmicheleome@gmail.com.
If you believe your data is being processed improperly, you may file a complaint with the Italian Data Protection Authority (www.garanteprivacy.it).

sections.title: 8. Cookies
paragraphs: For information about cookies, please see the Cookie Policy, which can be accessed via the link at the bottom of every page on the website.

sections.title: 9. Changes
paragraphs: This privacy policy may be updated from time to time. The date of the last update is indicated at the top of the page.

cookie.label: Privacy Policy
cookie.title: Cookies
cookie.intro: Cookies are small text files that a website saves on your device while you're browsing. This page explains which cookies the Hotel Ristorante San Michele website uses and how you can manage them.

sections.title: 1. In a nutshell
paragraphs: This site does not use profiling or advertising cookies. For this reason, we do not ask for your consent when you open the site.
Some content from other services (such as Google Maps) is loaded only if you choose to do so with a click.

sections.title: 2. Technical tools used by the website
paragraphs: • Language preference (site_lang): If you choose the Italian or English version, the site remembers your choice by saving it in your browser (local storage). It does not contain any personal data, does not expire, and you can delete it at any time from your browser settings.

• Visitor statistics (Vercel Web Analytics): We track, in an anonymous and aggregated manner, the pages visited, the referral source (e.g., Google, Instagram), the country, and the device type. The service does not use cookies, does not store anything on your device, and does not allow us to identify you or track you across other websites.
These tools are necessary for the website to function or collect only anonymous data, and do not require consent (Art. 122 of Legislative Decree 196/2003).

sections.title: 3. Third-Party Content
paragraphs: • Google Maps (Location page): The map is loaded only when you click “Show map.” From that point on, Google may set its own cookies and collect data such as your IP address, in accordance with its privacy policy: policies.google.com/privacy.

• OpenStreetMap (route maps in activity details): This is loaded when you open a details page that contains a map. The service may receive technical data such as your IP address: osmfoundation.org/wiki/Privacy_Policy.
• Google Fonts: The fonts used on this site are provided by Google. They do not set cookies, but your browser sends your IP address to Google in order to download them.

sections.title: 4. How to Manage or Delete Cookies
paragraphs: You can delete or block cookies at any time in your browser settings (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). If you block cookies, some third-party content, such as the map, may not work.

sections.title: 5. Data Controller and Contact Information
paragraphs: Hotel Ristorante San Michele — Via S. Michele, 5a, 25050 Ome (BS) — VAT No. 03524900986 — hotelsanmicheleome@gmail.com.
For more information on data processing, please see the Privacy Policy.
